summary: Sandbach United have made an impressive start to the season with back-to-back wins, including a victory over Wednesfield. Joe Bevan has reached a historic milestone, becoming the club's all-time leading scorer with 55 goals after bagging a brace in their recent match, surpassing James Kirby's previous record of 54. The Ramblers will be looking to extend their winning run when they visit Foley FC.
